title: What was the frill for?
hook: An impressive structure can have several proposed roles.

knows: Animals have structures that can have different roles.
doesNotKnow: Separate proposed functions from direct anatomical evidence.

misconception: A dramatic shape by itself proves a specific behavior.
objective: Separate proposed functions from direct anatomical evidence.

claims.text: An impressive structure can have several proposed roles. A fossil preserves a dinosaur’s horns and frill. What does their shape alone establish about their exact function? The schematic skull has horns and a frill. Defense and display are possible hypotheses, but the shape alone does not establish which function occurred, or whether a structure had more than one role. Each hypothesis needs additional evidence.

claims.text: The figure is a simplified, not-to-scale schematic of a stated example, not an image of an identified specimen.
Recall: A fossil structure has two plausible proposed functions. What is needed to choose between them? Competing functional explanations need evidence beyond the mere existence of a structure.
